references.text: Phinehas, son of Eleazar the priest, is the same one who showed zeal for God in the wilderness of Moab and received a promise of an everlasting priesthood
Describes the sending of Phinehas and the leaders to the land of Gilead to speak with the sons of Reuben and Gad
Phinehas and the leaders heard the explanation from the Transjordan tribes and were satisfied with the answer
The sons of Reuben and Gad asked to settle in the land of Gilead, east of the Jordan
Sending of representatives to bring back a report to the people of Israel, similar to other delegation missions
The sons of Reuben and Gad left Canaan for the land of Gilead and built an altar by the Jordan
